reason: I want to build the protected colon wall; the mucus belongs above the lining cells.
expectation: I expect the mucus to cover the colon lining, with supporting tissue and vessels still to add.

alternatives.reason: The microbes and fibre are another clear goal, but I want to start with the wall.

effect: The mucus now covers the lining, so I can add the tissue and vessels beneath it.
reaction: The picture makes the two sides of the lining clear.
reason: The supporting tissue and vessels belong beneath the lining, so this continues the colon wall.
expectation: I expect the mucus-covered lining to sit above the supporting tissue and blood vessels.

alternatives.reason: The microbes are a separate goal, but I want to continue building the wall first.

effect: The inner wall is complete, and I now know it recovers water and can use some molecules made by bacteria. The next wall goal is to add muscle.
reaction: The connection between bacterial products and fuel for lining cells is interesting.
reason: I want to finish the colon wall; the muscle surrounds the lining and moves the contents.
expectation: I expect the muscle wall to surround the inner wall, making a colon that can move its contents.

alternatives.reason: I also want to see what microbes make from fibre, but I'll finish the wall first.

effect: The colon now has a muscular outer wall, and the new goal is to connect it to the upper digestive tract.
reaction: It's clear how contractions move the contents while keeping them separate from the blood.
reason: I'll complete the continuous digestive tract by joining the colon to the small intestine.
expectation: I expect the upper tract to connect to the colon as one continuous tube.

alternatives.reason: The microbes and fibre are still a goal, but I want to finish connecting the tract first.

effect: The digestive tract is connected, leaving the microbe and fibre goal.
reaction: The distinction between food inside the tube and absorbed material crossing into blood is clear.
reason: This is the only available combination, and it addresses the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the microbes to turn some fibre into smaller molecules, though I don't know exactly how.

effect: The remaining goal is complete. I now know that some gut bacteria break down fibre into small fatty acids and gas, although some fibre remains.
reaction: The gas was a small surprise, and the result connects back to the lining cells using bacterial products.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile: it showed water crossing toward blood and connected bacterial products to fuel for lining cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was clear but fairly predictable on its own; the later wall result explained more.

surprise.text: I was surprised that bacteria produce gas as well as small fatty acids from some fibre.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless: the wall parts had visible positions, and the microbe pairing matched the goal. I followed that pairing without knowing exactly how the bacteria broke down fibre.

continue.text: I might continue to see another connection between body systems, though the straightforward wall fittings were not especially challenging.
